title: MPOLYGON metadata with valid associated-boundary identities
scope: Diagnose the two generated MPOLYGON metadata roundtrip failures
Exercise live group-330 association with collision-safe handle remapping
Register a focused fast CTest without adding persistent drawing fixtures

finding.observation: The generated associated-boundary case supplied a valid boundary polyline handle but left the MPOLYGON handle unset. Graph preflight correctly rejected the incomplete identity graph. After adding a unique MPOLYGON source handle, output succeeded; DXF handle remapping changed the raw source value, so the assertion was corrected to compare the imported loop reference with the imported boundary entity handle.

tests: Added a focused --mpolygon-metadata selector that runs ASCII and Binary boundary metadata roundtrips.
Added a valid unique MPOLYGON identity to the linked-polyline case and asserted the decoded association resolves to the imported polyline handle.
Added failure diagnostics for export/import outcome and decoded loop/reference/metadata state.

limitations: This generated roundtrip verifies local DXF association-handle remapping and metadata preservation. It does not qualify native associative editing/recomputation, external CAD compatibility, or production support claims. The worktree contains broader pre-existing user changes and remains uncommitted.
